tool: Codex CLI 0.169.0 (codex exec), built-in image generation tool image_gen.imagegen, ChatGPT sign-in
image_model: not exposed by the Codex image tool
prompt:
Use your image generation tool, with the attached image as the reference to edit/trace (keep its composition).
Make ONE image: full colour manga setting art (character/setting sheet), clean even thin black main line, flat cel colours (no gradients, no painterly texture, minimal shading).
Early-18th-century English clothes and ships. No likeness to any film, game or existing illustration.
Keep the reference's proportions, pose, camera angle and framing exactly; same position and size in the frame. Landscape orientation 1536x1024.
Ignore and do not draw the orange bone lines and dots in the reference, and do not draw the grey floor grid.
Background must be pure flat white (#FFFFFF) everywhere outside the figure: no floor, no grid, no shadow.
No text, no speech balloons, no signature, no watermark.
Subject: Two figures together at true scale, exactly as placed in the reference: the big man is Gulliver (Lemuel Gulliver, ship's surgeon, 1,750 mm tall, about 30. Blue coat, tan breeches, white stockings, black shoes, short brown hair tied back, clean-shaven, tired but curious face.) and the tiny one standing by his foot is a Lilliputian courtier in a dark red coat, grey breeches and small sword, a normal adult man only 146 mm tall whose head reaches just above Gulliver's ankle. Keep the tiny figure's exact size and position.
After generating, copy the generated PNG to ./raw.png in the current directory. Do not generate more than one image.
post_processing: _tools/split.py: figure scaled/positioned to the underlay figure box, white background flood-filled to transparent; line layer = thin dark strokes (morphological close minus luminance), fill layer = image with strokes inpainted. Composite = un-split image at underlay size.
